faqs.q: How fast do your SOC engineers respond to high-severity inquiries?
faqs.a: Critical telemetry alerts and active breach reports are triaged within 15 minutes by a dedicated Level-3 Security Architect, 24/7/365.

faqs.q: Can we schedule a private architectural walkthrough for our team?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose 'Red Team Walkthrough' above to book an interactive demonstration customized to your Kubernetes, bare-metal, or hybrid cloud architecture.

faqs.q: Where can independent researchers submit zero-day disclosures?
faqs.a: Select 'Research / Disclosure'. Every responsible disclosure is encrypted with our PGP public key, triaged within 4 hours, and rewarded through our Bug Bounty Program.

faqs.q: Do you provide on-premise air-gapped deployment consultations?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Sovereign Enclave tier supports complete air-gapped installation and compliance certification. Inquire under Enterprise Sales for compliance documentation.
